$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_MYUNIT1|0|$t1$Wmusername|7$w0|$Wsusername|$Wa$Wmヘンリー|3$w0|$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_11|Hé, $Nu. J'ai fini de rapiécer
les tentes. Et maintenant ?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_20|Hmm... Voyons voir... Livres rangés, sol
balayé, armes entretenues...$k$pJe crois que c'était tout.
Merci beaucoup pour ton aide !$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_9|Hmm... D'accord. Et donc, qu'est-ce que
je dois faire maintenant ?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_10|Euh... Eh bien, tu peux faire ce que tu veux,
aller où bon te semble.$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_7|Oh, vraiment ? Dans ce cas, je vais
rester ici, avec toi.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_7|Oh, vraiment ?$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_2|Oui, j'adore être avec toi, $Nu.
Et j'adore faire tes corvées.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_17|Ha ! Eh bien, j'apprécie moi aussi
ta compagnie, Henry.$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_12|Hmm... En fait, quand j'ai dit que j'adorais
être avec toi, tu ne m'as pas compris.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_5|Hein ? Apparemment, non. Pourtant,
tu es plutôt direct, d'habitude.$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_1|Hi hi ! Je sais... Qu'est-ce qui me prend ?
Tiens, c'est de ça que je parlais...$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_10|Un anneau ?
Un anneau vraiment très... sinistre ?$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_2|Oh, ne fais pas attention au crâne et aux
serpents dessus... Il n'est pas maudit.$k$pJe n'essaierais jamais de maudire quelqu'un
que j'aime autant que toi.$k$pJ'ai choisi moi-même cet anneau de
fiançailles... Je voudrais t'épouser !$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_18|Eh bien, c'est... inattendu...$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_19|Hi hi ! Tu n'aurais jamais cru que je ferais
une chose pareille de mon propre chef ?$k$pMais c'est ce que je veux, du plus profond
de moi. Alors, qu'est-ce que tu en dis ?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,照|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_16|J'accepte, Henry, de tout mon cœur.$k$pTu n'as pas besoin de me jeter un sort,
je suis déjà sous ton charme.$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$E笑,照|$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_20|Waouh !$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,照|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_22|Mais tu dois me promettre que nous
serons ensemble pour toujours.$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_7|Oh, tu peux compter sur moi.
Je fais toujours ce qu'on me dit !$k

$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_MYUNIT1|0|$t1$Wmusername|7$w0|$Wsusername|$Wa$Wmヘンリー|3$w0|$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_11|He, $Nu. Die Zelte sind alle
aufgebaut. Was soll ich als Nächstes tun?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_20|Mal sehen. Du hast meine Bücher sortiert,
den Boden gewischt, die Waffen überprüft...$k$pIch glaube, das wäre dann wirklich alles.
Vielen Dank für deine Hilfe!$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_9|Ja, schon gut. Aber was soll ich denn nun
als Nächstes machen?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_10|Na ja, mach einfach, worauf du Lust hast.$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_7|Oh, echt? Dann bleibe ich hier bei dir.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_7|Ähm, wirklich?$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_2|Ich bin gerne bei dir, $Nu. Und
ich liebe es, Sachen für dich zu erledigen.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_17|Ha! Das ist sehr nett von dir. Ich bin auch
gerne in deiner Gesellschaft.$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_12|Geeenau. Und wenn ich "gerne" sage, meine
ich damit etwas ganz Besonderes.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_5|Hä? Ich bin verwirrt, Henry. Du sprichst
doch sonst auch nicht in Rätseln.$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_1|Ehehe! Ich weiß! Was ist nur mit mir los?
Hier, der ist für dich...$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_10|Du gibst mir einen Ring? Einen sehr
unheimlich aussehenden Ring?$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_2|Oh, beachte all die Schlangen und
Totenköpfe gar nicht. Er ist nicht verflucht.$k$pIch würde nie jemanden verfluchen, den ich
so sehr mag.$k$pEs ist ein ganz besonderer Verlobungsring!
Ich möchte, dass wir heiraten!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_18|Das... überrumpelt mich jetzt etwas.$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_19|Ehehe! Dachtest du, ich würde so was nur
auf Befehl machen?$k$pAber es war abso-tiv und defini-lut meine
eigene Idee. Was sagst du dazu?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,照|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_16|Ich nehme deinen Antrag aus ganzem
Herzen an, Henry.$k$pAuch wenn du mich nicht verflucht hast,
stehe ich ganz in deinem Bann.$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$E笑,照|$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_20|Ach, das ist spitze!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,照|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_22|Aber versprich mir, mich bis ans Ende
meiner Tage glücklich zu machen.$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_7|Oh, verlass dich auf mich. Ich mache immer
das, was man mir sagt!$k

$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_MYUNIT1|0|$t1$Wmusername|7$w0|$Wsusername|$Wa$Wmヘンリー|3$w0|$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_11|Ehi, $Nu. Ho finito di montare
le tende. Ora cosa dovrei fare?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_20|Vediamo... Hai ordinato i miei libri, lucidato
le armi, spazzato il pavimento...$k$pCredo sia davvero tutto.
Grazie mille per il tuo aiuto.$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_9|Di nulla. Ma adesso cosa potrei fare?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_10|Beh, adesso sei libero di andare
e fare ciò che desideri.$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_7|Oh, davvero? Se è così, resterò
qui a chiacchierare con te.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_7|Ehm... Davvero?$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_2|È divertente stare con te, $Nu.
Mi piace aiutarti nei lavori domestici.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_17|Ah! Sei molto gentile. Anche a me
fa piacere la tua compagnia.$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_12|Solo che quando dico "divertente", intendo
dire che mi piace in modo... speciale.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_5|Speciale? Sono confusa, Henry.
Di solito non sei così oscuro nel parlare.$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_1|Niah ah ah! Lo so! Cosa mi è preso?
Tieni, questo dovrebbe chiarirti le idee...$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_10|Mi stai dando un anello?
Un anello piuttosto inquietante, direi.$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_2|Oh, non badare ai teschi e ai serpenti
incisi sopra. Non è maledetto.$k$pNon proverei mai a maledire una persona
che mi piace così tanto come te.$k$pÈ un anello di fidanzamento che ho
scelto io stesso. Vorrei sposarti!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_18|Oh... Non me l'aspettavo.$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_19|Niah ah! Non mi credevi capace di un gesto
simile senza che me lo ordini qualcuno?$k$pE invece è proprio un'idea del sottoscritto.
Allora, cosa rispondi?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,照|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_16|Accetto, Henry. Accetto con tutto il cuore.$k$pForse non mi hai maledetta, ma in qualche
modo sei riuscito comunque a stregarmi.$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$E笑,照|$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_20|Magnifico!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,照|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_22|Però devi promettermi di rendermi
felice per il resto della mia vita.$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_7|Oh, ci puoi contare.
Faccio sempre quello che mi viene chiesto!$k

$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_MYUNIT1|0|$t1$Wmusername|7$w0|$Wsusername|$Wa$Wmヘンリー|3$w0|$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_11|¡Oye, $Nu! ¡Ya he arreglado esas
tiendas! ¿Qué quieres que haga ahora?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_20|Bueno, veamos... Has ordenado mis libros,
barrido el suelo, revisado las armas...$k$pCreo que eso es todo. Muchas gracias por
tu ayuda.$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_9|Vale, pero... ¿qué hago ahora?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_10|Bueno, supongo que ahora puedes
hacer lo que quieras.$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_7|Ah, ¿de verdad? Si eso es así, me gustaría
quedarme aquí y pasar un rato contigo.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_7|Vaya, ¿en serio?$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_2|Me divierte estar contigo, $Nu.
Y me encanta hacer tareas para ti.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_17|¡Ja! Bueno, yo también disfruto
con tu compañía, Henry.$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_12|Pero cuando digo que me lo paso bien
contigo, me refiero a que es algo especial...$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_5|¿Cómo? Estoy confundida, Henry.
Normalmente nunca te vas por las ramas.$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_1|¡Ji, ja, ja! ¿A que no? ¿Qué habrá pasado?
Toma, ahora entenderás de lo que hablo...$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_10|¿Me estás dando un anillo?
Un anillo más que siniestro, por cierto...$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_2|Ignora los cráneos y serpientes que lo
decoran. No está maldito ni nada de eso.$k$pNo podría maldecir a alguien que me gusta
tanto como tú...$k$pEs un anillo de compromiso que encargué
para ti. ¡Quiero que nos casemos!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_18|Esto sí que no... me lo esperaba.$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_19|¡Jia, ja! No creías que fuera capaz de hacer
algo así sin que me lo ordenaran, ¿eh?$k$pSin embargo, esta idea es mía y solo mía.
¿Qué me dices?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,照|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_16|Acepto, Henry. Acepto de todo corazón.$k$pPuede que no me hayas maldecido, pero
he caído bajo tu hechizo...$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$E笑,照|$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_20|¡Sí!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,照|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_22|Pero debes prometerme que estaremos
juntos para siempre.$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_7|Oh, puedes contar con ello.
¡Yo siempre obedezco a mis superiores!$k

$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_MYUNIT1|0|$t1$Wmusername|7$w0|$Wsusername|$Wa$Wmヘンリー|3$w0|$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_11|Hey, $Nu. I'm done mending
those tents! What should I do next?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_20|Well, let's see. You've sorted my books,
swept the floor, checked the weapons...$k$pI do believe that's absolutely everything.
Thank you so much for the help.$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_9|Yeah, okay... But what should I do now?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_10|Well, I guess you're free to go
and do whatever you want.$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_7|Oh, really? In that case, I'll stay right
here and hang out with you.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_7|Um, you will?$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_2|It's fun being around you, $Nu.
And I especially love doing your chores.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_17|Ha! Well, I enjoy your
company, too, Henry.$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_12|...But when I say it's "fun" being
with you, I mean it's...kind of special.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_5|Huh? I'm confused, Henry.
It's not like you to be so oblique.$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_1|Nya ha! I know, right? What's got into me?
Here, this is what I'm talking about...$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_10|You're giving me a ring?
...A very sinister-looking ring?$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_2|Oh, don't mind the skulls and snakes
carved in it. It's not cursed or anything.$k$pI could never curse anyone I liked
as much as I like you...$k$pIt's an engagement ring that I picked
out special. I want us to get married!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_18|This is...unexpected.$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_19|Nya ha! You didn't think I'd do something
like this without someone ordering me, huh?$k$pBut it's abso-tively posi-lutely my own idea.
So what do you say?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,照|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_16|I accept, Henry. I accept wholeheartedly.$k$pYou may not have cursed me, but I seem
to have fallen under your spell...$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$E笑,照|$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_20|Yes!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,照|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_22|But you must promise me we'll
be together forever.$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_7|Oh, you can count on me.
I always do as I'm told!$k

$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_MYUNIT1|0|$t1$Wmusername|7$w0|$Wsusername|$Wa$Wmヘンリー|3$w0|$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$E笑|$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_11|Hey, $Nu. Çadırları onardım!
Şimdi ne yapayım?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_20|Bakalım. Kitapları dizdin, yeri süpürdün,
silahları kontrol ettin...$k$pSanırım gerçekten her şey bitti.
Çok teşekkür ederim.$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_9|Tamam... Peki şimdi ne yapayım?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_10|Artık serbestsin.
Ne istersen yap.$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$E通常|$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_7|Gerçekten mi? O zaman burada
seninle takılacağım.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,汗|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_7|Benimle mi?$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$E笑|$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_2|Seninle olmak eğlenceli, $Nu.
İşlerini yapmayı da seviyorum.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_17|Ha! Ben de seninle
vakit geçirmeyi seviyorum, Henry.$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$E通常|$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_12|Ama 'eğlenceli' derken...
daha özel bir şey kastediyorum.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_5|Ne demek istiyorsun Henry?
Böyle dolaylı konuşmazdın.$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$E笑|$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_1|Nya ha! Değil mi? Bana ne oldu?
Al, demek istediğim bu...$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_10|Bana yüzük mü veriyorsun?
...Hem de epey uğursuz bir yüzük?$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_2|Kafatası ve yılanlara aldırma.
Lanetli falan değil.$k$pSeni sevdiğim kadar sevdiğim
birine asla lanet etmem...$k$pÖzel seçtiğim nişan yüzüğü.
Evlenmemizi istiyorum!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_18|Bu... beklenmedikti.$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_19|Nya ha! Emir almadan böyle bir şey
yapacağımı düşünmedin, değil mi?$k$pAma tamamen kendi fikrim!
Ne diyorsun?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,照|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_16|Kabul ediyorum, Henry.
Hem de bütün kalbimle.$k$pBeni lanetlemedin ama sanırım
büyüne kapıldım...$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$E笑,照|$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_20|Evet!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,照|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_22|Ama sonsuza dek birlikte
olacağımıza söz vermelisin.$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_7|Bana güven.
Ben hep söyleneni yaparım!$k

I:
$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_MYUNIT1|0|$t1$Wmusername|7$w0|$Wsusername|$Wa$Wmヘンリー|3$w0|$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_11|$Nu、天幕張り終わったよ～。
他に何か頼みたいことは無いの～？$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_20|そうですね…戦術書の整理も、掃除も、
武器の点検も、食料調達も終わりましたし…$k$pもうありません。ありがとうございます。
ヘンリーさん。おかげで助かりました。$k
$Wsヘンリー|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_HENRI_EVT_9|じゃあどうすればいいの～？$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_F#_EVT_10|えぇっ？　どうすればって…$k$p今からはヘンリーさんのしたいことを
すればいいのですよ。$k
